newsitem.title: FRANCE: Car bomb kills six, 20 wounded in central Algiers.
newsitem.headline: Car bomb kills six, 20 wounded in central Algiers.

text.p: A car bomb exploded in central Algiers on Tuesday afternoon, killing six people and wounding about 20, several of whom were in a critical state, security forces said.

An official source told Reuters by telephone that the security forces said the bomb went off at 14.15 (1315 GMT) near the main university faculty. The authorities have blamed previous bomb attacks on Moslem fundamentalists.
